newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish Ryanair launches shares at 195 Irish pence.
newsitem.headline: Irish Ryanair launches shares at 195 Irish pence.

text.p: Irish 'low cost, no-frills' airline on Thursday launched a 54.2 million share issue at a price of 195 pence per share.
Morgan Stanley Securities Ltd, as stabilising manager, said stabilisation transactions may occur during the period May 29 to June 27.
Ryanair, which floated on both New York's Nasdaq and Ireland's ISEQ index, the first Irish company to seek a simultaneous quote both sides of the Atlantic, said the issue was 15 times oversubscribed.
This capitalises the company, which has a total share issue of 158.3 million shares, at in excess of 300 million Irish pounds.
The share issue was priced on New York's Nasdaq at $14.73 per share.
